spec.name: M5.CompletionBlock.support_union
spec.statement: ∀ A U : Finset ℕ, Disjoint A U → M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (A ∪ U) = M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A + M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U
spec.guidance: Unfold ofSupport and use Finset.sum_union with disjointness. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.CompletionBlock.union_divisibility
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (A U : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A U → (P ∣ M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (A ∪ U) ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport U) = AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A))
spec.guidance: Use support_union, AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero and map_add. In characteristic2, x+y=0 iff y=x. No nonzero or irreducibility premise; empty selected/extension sets allowed. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.CompletionBlock.completion_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (A W : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ), Disjoint A W → M5.ArithmeticSubset.n P hP W k (AdjoinRoot.mk P (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport A)) = (M5.CompletionBlock.count P A W k : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Rewrite M5.ArithmeticSubset.n_exact. Each U∈W.powersetCard k is subset W, hence Disjoint A U. Unfold count and equate filters using union_divisibility. Classical decidability is allowed; do not replace n definition by cardinality or enumerate support pairs. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
